# Lamplighter on GitHub

Everything a README on GitHub may use :tada:, in one document. See https://example.com/lamp for the
project's site, and ~~the old wiki~~ the [guide](docs/guide.md).

## Alerts

> [!NOTE]
> Cards print on A6 and A7.

> [!TIP]
> `lamp build --dark` saves toner on dark cards.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Every card needs a title.

> [!WARNING]
> Glossy paper smudges.

> [!CAUTION]
> `lamp clean` deletes the printed folder.

## Tables and task lists

| Option   | Meaning                        | Default |
| :------- | :----------------------------- | ------: |
| `--size` | Card size, `a6` or `a7`        |    `a6` |
| `--dark` | Print light text on dark cards |   `off` |

- [x] Update the changelog
- [ ] Tag the version
  - [ ] Write the notes
- [ ] Publish

## Footnotes

Cards print best on matte paper.[^paper] Most printers take it.[^printers]

[^paper]: 200 g/m² or heavier.
[^printers]: Check the tray's limit first.

## What's new?

### Über die Karten

Headings with punctuation and non-ASCII text get the same anchors as on GitHub.

## Install

Once for each user.

## Install

Again, so this one's anchor is `install-1`.

```sh
lamp --version
```

> Quotes keep their border.
